A suite of DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugins that brings **ChatGPT/OpenAI Codex models** and a **Codex-
style conversation experience** to the DSH Web UI. Built against DSH `0.2.2-rc.1` (peer range `>=0.2

The two plugins are fully decoupled: the Conversation UI works with any model, and the Codex Provide
r works with the stock chat UI.
## Why this suite
**Codex Provider — reliable ChatGPT access without an API key**
- **ChatGPT OAuth, both flows.** Browser-based login with device-code fallback. Login failures are c
lassified into secret-free, localized reasons (region restrictions, callback port conflicts, token e

xchange errors, network issues…) instead of raw stack traces.
- **IPv6 loopback callback bridge.** p
i-ai's OAuth listener only binds IPv4; on IPv6-preferred hosts the suite transparently relays the lo

opback callback, so login still works.
- **Proactive token refresh.** Access tokens rotate ~5 minute
s before expiry with retry backoff; a dead refresh token is detected precisely and surfaces as *reco

nnect required* instead of failing mid-stream.
- **Usage dashboard.** Plan (shown under its user-fac
ing name such as Plus, Pro 5x, or Pro 20x), credits, and primary/secondary rate-limit windows with u

sed-percent bars and reset times, fetched from the account-scoped ChatGPT endpoint.
- **Banked rate-
limit resets.** View how many resets the account has banked and their earliest expiry, then redeem o

ne from a confirmation dialog to restore the 5-hour and weekly limit windows.
- **Proxy-aware networ
king.** Auto-detects environment and system proxies (macOS / Windows / Linux), routes only OpenAI tr
affic through them, keeps loopback direct, and exposes an explicit proxy mode (auto / environment /

off).
- **Reliability-first defaults.** SSE transport by default (no partial-output duplication on W

ebSocket failure), 5-minute stream idle timeout, configurable retry policy.
- **Native Settings page
** at *Plugins → DSH Codex Suite → codex-provider* localized in all eight DSH built-in languages (zh
/en/ja/es/fr/de/ru/pt), with live status, and a loopback-only RPC boundary — credentials never leave
fr/de/ru/pt), with live status, and a loopback-only RPC boundary — credentials never leave the Host.
**Conversation UI — enhancements within native DSH chat**
- **Native presentation.** DSH owns tool groups, work-details modes, process folding, running status

, and viewport restoration.

## Quick start

1. Install the suite (see above) and open the Web UI (`dsh web`).
2. Go to **Plugins → DSH Codex Sui
te → codex-provider**, click **Connect**, and choose **Browser login** (or **Device login** on a hea

dless/remote machine). Complete the ChatGPT authorization.
3. Back in the chat, pick an `openai-code

x` model in the model selector and start talking.

## Architecture
Each runtime plugin ships two halves:
- **Host half** (Node) — Cordis plugin: provider registration, OAuth lifecycle, networking, settings

persistence. Loaded from the package root.
- **Web half** (browser) — React views discovered throug
h the `dsh.client` manifest. The Codex Provider contributes the Settings section; the Conversation U
I replaces the assistant node view and wraps tool rows.
The halves communicate through two narrow channels: an inline **boot-config global** (`window.__DSH_
CONVERSATION_UI_CONFIG__`) injected into the served HTML carries validated plugin config to the brow
ser, and the **authenticated Connection RPC** carries settings reads/writes back to the Host. Secret
s (tokens, proxy URLs) never cross the RPC boundary.
Package-level docs: codex-provider · conversation-ui · suite
## DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 compatibility
The provider uses pi-ai `1.3.0`, matching the DSH adapter, and the suite builds against the DSH `0.2
.2-rc.1` closure (cordis `4.1.0`, loader `1.1.0`, schemastery `3.19.0`). The Conversation UI leaves
live status and scrolling to DSH 0.2 and uses its localized duration units for completed Turns, incl
uding stopped and failed outcomes. Both plugins typecheck, pass their unit suites, and boot in an is
olated DSH `0.2.2-rc.1` Web profile: the boot graph serves both client bundles, the Conversation UI
boot-config global is injected into the served HTML, and both plugin RPC channels answer through the
Connection fence. A Playwright pass over that Web profile then confirmed the browser side end to en
d: both plugin pages and both settings cards render, the eight DSH built-in languages switch live, a
nd the console stays clean. Restart DSH after replacing an older plugin version.
